title: Lamb Cassoulet Tartiflette
description: A unique fusion of Chinese flavors and French cuisine, this hearty dish combines the rich flavors of lamb with the savory taste of tartiflette.
instructions: Season the lamb shoulder with Chinese five-spice and salt.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb shoulder until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the lamb to the preheated oven and cook for 2 hours, or until tender.
While the lamb is cooking, prepare the tartiflette according to the package instructions.
Add the French green beans to the Dutch oven and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Once the lamb is done, let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing.
Serve the sliced lamb with the tartiflette and green beans.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
